summary: Create-character name field drops the first typed character
author: pm
body:
During the HH-0042 in-world tests, two character names typed into the create-character name field through the agent bridge each lost their first character. `Tst3843` became `st3843`, and `Tq7724` became `q7724`; the field itself already showed `q7724` before Create was pressed.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| same text into chat via the bridge (`text`, `set_text`) | intact, capital first letter kept (journal `chat_send`, measured) |
| bridge waits one presented frame before the first character (fix in b2fa2e1) | still lost (measured) |
| typed with a real keyboard | unverified |

So the loss is in the create-character name field or its focus handling, not in the bridge's text path. It is not known whether a real player sees it too, or whether it only drops a leading capital or `T`.

**Done when:** the cause is found; a name typed into the create-character field, by keyboard and through the bridge, keeps every character; reviewed.

Source: tester report 2026-11-24; test account `hhtest8489` (`.claude/local/test_accounts.json`).
